name: Tegra Medical LLC
old_description: Our people are at the heart of what we do. They are driving force behind our success as a contract manufacturer of medical devices. Their expertise, dedication, and passion ensure that we consistently deliver high-quality products and services to our customers.
about:
Tegra Medical operates from its headquarters in Franklin, Massachusetts, with additional manufacturing sites in Costa Rica, Switzerland, Malaysia, China, and Singapore. The company describes itself as a contract manufacturer with decades of expertise in the medical device sector, though a specific founding year and founder names are not disclosed in its public materials.

Tegra Medical provides end-to-end contract manufacturing for medical devices, spanning design and prototyping at its GENESIS Tech Center® through full-scale production, assembly, packaging, and sterilization. Core processes include injection molding, precision grinding for sharp tips, and wire and tubing fabrication with secondary operations such as cutting, coating, and custom mandrel work. The company highlights a global footprint across six countries but does not publish facility square footage, headcount, or annual part volumes.

The firm serves medical device OEMs across oncology, ophthalmics, women's health, advanced orthopedics (including spine and trauma implants), minimally invasive surgery, drug delivery, cardiovascular and neurology, cardiac rhythm management, and robotic-assisted surgery. Its Quick Wire & Tubing store supports cardiovascular and neurovascular prototyping with off-the-shelf and customized stainless steel, nitinol, and coated wire and tubing.

Tegra Medical emphasizes a 'true end-to-end' model that consolidates the supply chain for customers, backed by ISO 13485 certification, FDA QSR compliance, and FDA registration. The company cites black-belt certified engineers, real-time statistical process control, lean and Six Sigma methodologies, and sustainability investments such as solar power and Industry 4.0 automation as differentiators.
